title: Noise Mitigation Measures for Residents near Tampines Expressway and Loyang Flyover Construction Work Sites
what_it_is: Noise Mitigation Measures for Residents near Tampines Expressway and Loyang Flyover Construction Work Sites

sections.label: Expressway construction noise mitigation measures
sections.summary: Interim measures include temporary noise barriers, machinery enclosures, rubber tools, daytime noisy works and noise meters, with permanent barriers and low noise pavement after completion.

sentences.speaker: Dr Charlene Chen
sentences.text: asked the Acting Minister for Transport (a) what interim noise mitigation measures are in place near the Tampines Expressway and the Loyang Flyover construction work sites; (b) how is post-completion noise impact of such sites assessed; and (c) whether additional safeguards will be implemented to protect residents' sleep, health and children's learning environment in the interim.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: These include temporary noise barriers, enclosures around machinery, the use of special tools such as rubber materials for hammering works, as well as carrying out noisier works as far as possible during the day.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Noise meters are also installed to ensure that noise levels do not exceed the levels stipulated by the National Environment Agency (NEA).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Post-construction, permanent noise barriers will be erected along the section of Loyang Viaduct facing residential blocks.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Transport (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Acting Minister for Transport)
sentences.text: Low noise pavement mix that better absorb noise will also be used for the road surface.

sections.label: Reducing noise impact on residents
sections.summary: The Minister says the answer is yes and that ways will be planned to reduce noise impact on residents near road infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: The quick short answer to most of her questions is yes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: We will plan and look for ways to reduce noise, noise impact on residents living near road infrastructure.

sections.label: Additional measures and noise-reducing pavement
sections.summary: When infrastructure mitigation is inadequate, other agencies will help add measures, and the new section will use noise-reducing pavement mix.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: When infrastructure-level kind of mitigation are not adequate, we will definitely look at possible ways, working with other agencies to see how we can add on to the measures to reduce the impact on residents living around it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: As for noise reducing pavement mix, we have a schedule of resurfacing these expressways, especially near residential areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: But this new section that we are building near Dr Chan's residents will already be using the noise-reducing mix for the road surface.
